steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Verify you meet the specific hour and experience thresholds before applying. Granite PM Academy's advisors can review your background and confirm readiness at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions from your Evansville location on a schedule that fits your work commitments. All contact hours are logged and formally documented for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI through their online portal. Include your training documentation and project-experience records. Pay the required PMI exam fee once your application is approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce course material. Schedule your proctored exam at an authorized testing center. Pass the PMP exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, and professional activities to renew. Stay current with PMI requirements to keep your credential active and recognized in your field.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
